descriptionHtml: In this Awareness session of efforts taken to make the community aware about Predicta v1.0 as well as   about   preparing for the competition. The awareness session conducted as the first of a series of events   under the   program Predicta v1.0. The awareness session provided valuable insights and knowledge-   sharing   opportunities for students, leading the way to this event here at University of Peradeniya. The   session was   conducted by Thimira Hirushan who was the program team lead and the project team lead   of this event,   undergraduate at Faculty of Engineering, University of Peradeniya.
